MANUAL.description: Crane is operated manually by a human operator

SEMIAUTOMATIC.description: Some or all of crane motions are automated, but a human operator is required in the loop.

FULLAUTOMATIC.description: All of the crane motions are automated. No human intervention is required.

BYPASS_ON.description: A function, such as an assistive feature, is bypassed on the crane, e. g. to continue productive work in case a non-critical function suffers a fault.

MAINTENANCE.description: Crane is in maintenance mode, typically operating at reduced speed and possibly with some protective functions disabled so they will not hinder or prohibit service activities.
